nameOrigin: large reptile with a protective shell

pokedexEntries.rb: A brutal POKéMON with pressurized water jets on its shell. They are used for high speed tackles.

pokedexEntries.ye: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.

pokedexEntries.go: It deliberately makes itself heavy so it can withstand the recoil of the water jets it fires.

pokedexEntries.si: The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.

pokedexEntries.cr: It firmly plants its feet on the ground before shooting water from the jets on its back.

pokedexEntries.rs: BLASTOISE has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.

pokedexEntries.fr: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
